# origincloud_network_resolver_policy_associations (Data Source)

Lists a VPC's resolver policy associations: none or one.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project whose resolver policy associations to list.
- `region` (String) The region whose resolver policy associations to list.
- `vpc` (String) The vpc whose resolver policy associations to list. Its `id`, the full resource name `//network.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/vpcs/{vpc}`. `project` and `region` must be the ones it is in.

### Read-Only

- `resolver_policy_associations` (Attributes List) The resolver policy associations listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resolver_policy_associations))

<a id="nestedatt--resolver_policy_associations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resolver_policy_associations`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The resolver policy association's full resource name, `//network.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/vpcs/{vpc}/resolverPolicyAssociations/{resolver_policy_association}`: what an argument that refers to the resolver policy association takes. `name` is the relative name, without the host.
- `name` (String) The association's resource name. Its last segment is the resolver policy's id.
- `resolver_policy` (String) The full name of the resolver policy the VPC relays through, in the VPC's project and region.
